objective: Sell and deliver four bounded USD 250 bilingual pronunciation mini-lessons to tutors or small language schools while keeping the L & N learner app free.

offer.buyer: A tutor or small language school with one defined learner group and one recurring sound contrast
offer.scope: One pronunciation contrast, one learner group, English plus Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese
deliverables: two short model-audio prompts and readable phonetic cues
original teaching visuals for the relevant contact, airflow, or sound pattern
one responsive and printable four-step web lesson
offer.delivery: Within ten business days after payment and complete agreed inputs
offer.payment_gate: Give a fit or no-fit answer, then accept the exact words, learner context, language, source rights, delivery date, correction boundary, cancellation, and refund terms in writing before requesting payment.
offer.refund: Full refund before work begins; after work begins, refund unstarted stages.
excluded: app integration, hosting, or a custom domain

proof.live_checks: The offer, sample, app, stylesheet, sitemap, signed Android test build, privacy page, HTTPS headers, and rollback release were verified after the immutable 2026-09-11 deployment.
proof.boundary: The sample is project-owned proof of the delivery format. It is not customer work, a testimonial, a clinical result, a certified translation, or evidence of sales.

owned_sample.route: The free sample contains one quiet, exact-fit link for tutors.

linkedin.content:
Some pronunciation problems are too small for a full course and too persistent for another list of tips.

I built this light/night lesson so a learner can hear the contrast, see the air path, try a short phrase, and come back later. It works without an account or microphone.

For tutors and small language schools, I’m now offering the same format for one contrast your learners keep mixing up: a bilingual web lesson with model audio, original teaching visuals, printable steps, a short captioned walkthrough, and one correction pass. The founding pack is USD 250 after a fit check and written scope.

Finished sample and scope:
https://l-and-n.lazying.art/for-tutors/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=pronunciation_mini_lesson_pilot&utm_content=light_night_sample
